articles.summary: In the Phase 2/3 COMPANION-002 study of tovecimig (DLL4 x VEGF-A bispecific antibody) in patients with biliary tract cancer, the prespecified event threshold of 80% overall survival (OS) events was reached in Q1 2026; as a result, the analyses of progression-free survival (PFS) and OS are expected
